coverage.finding: The top-left page label reads '130' with a superscript 'b' and a dot after it. A short dash-like stroke to its right appears to be a stray mark. The label is correctly treated as a page number.

This is a single unshelfmarked line on a ruled line at about y 1550–1600. The reading matches the source within the stated uncertainty. The ending of 'hand[s]' is cursive and the final 's' is not secure. The mark after 'section' may be a comma or only a pen tail. 'V' after 'RLM.' is underlined.

The line begins with a tick and 'C.375(5).' and the digits read as 375 in the native tile. The bracketed insertion's closing bracket is written as a curly-brace-like stroke and is followed by a comma. 'n.d.:10:11/13:Beng.' runs up to the gutter at about x 3150. 'to wh.' is still uncertain.

The bottom line is at about y 4320–4400 and has no shelfmark. The terminal string '1. c. 02/.I.71' (or 'l.c. ...') is legible as strokes but its function is uncertain. It may be initials plus a date of the same kind as strings on fol. 131 (e.g. near d.308(2) and d.326(3)), but that is not established. The candidate's 'date' field overstates this.

An 'L'/angle mark sits at about [3120,1580,40,45], just left of the gutter, at the level of the b002 line. Attaching it to r002 is plausible. The pairing with the mark beside c.376b on fol. 131 is inferred from position only.

changes.reason: The terminal string may be initials or an abbreviation followed by a date-like sequence. Its first characters are uncertain. Recording it as a secure date field implies a function that the source does not establish.

unresolved.issue: It is unclear whether the text reads 'hand.' or 'hands.' The punctuation after 'section' is also unclear.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect the end of the word at about x 1850–2000, y 1560–1600 at higher magnification.

unresolved.issue: The phrase read as 'to wh.' (about x 900–1050, y 1630–1680) could equally be 'to which' or another abbreviation. The ditto antecedent on fol. 131 is inferred from the arrow only.
unresolved.next_check: Compare the letter forms with the same hand elsewhere. Examine the fol. 131 c.376b line at native resolution.

unresolved.issue: The reading and function of '1. c. 02/.I.71' are uncertain. Attachment to fol. 131 c.89(3) rests on a left-pointing arrow. The spelling Kāśī-/Kāśi- in 'Kāśīmāhātmya' is cursive and uncertain.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with similar terminal strings on fol. 131 lines d.308(2) and d.326(3).

review.boundary_review: The gutter is at about x 3180–3195. Everything to its right belongs to fol. 131 and is not transcribed here. The b003 string ends at about x 3150, before the gutter. The L mark (b901) is on the target side. Attachments of b002/b003 to c.376b and of b004 to c.89(3) on fol. 131 remain inferred.
